evidence: Touches the depends recipe for qrencode and bears the Build system label.
rationale: Fixes an upstream 404 URL in the depends build system by switching to GitHub with a distinct tarball name to avoid cache collisions. As noted in the description, 'https://fukuchi.org/works/qrencode/qrencode-4.1.1.tar.gz returns 404, so depends takes qrencode from the bitcoincore.org fallback', and using a new filename follows up on discussion from #33577 to protect fallback integrity across release branches.
